title: Pickup service vs a shared storage unit
description: What changes when Texas A&M roommates split a climate-controlled room instead of paying a pickup company per box.
intro: A pickup company prices each box and brings it back to the room. A storage unit prices the room, and you do the hauling. The room gets cheaper per person when roommates share a lock.
The unit side uses CubeSmart's in-store price on Manuel Drive, because the page does not say how long the cheaper online price lasts.

left.text: No separate online box discount is published for the $56 rate.
Collegeboxes, on a scheduled date, if full-service pickup is actually open.

right.text: You do. Dollies are not listed on the Manuel Drive amenity list.

rows.label: Getting it back to the room

left.text: A published room delivery is January 19, 2027. A later or earlier date is a contact-us question, and the national off-date fee is $500.

right.text: You pick it up during access hours, daily 6:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m.

takeaway: Five boxes at the $56 national rate are $280 for four months. A heated-and-cooled 5x10 at the $100 in-store price is $400 for four months before tax and before the unpublished admin fee (a one-time move-in charge). Split by two roommates, the room is $200 each, and it can hold more than five boxes.
The room wins on published dollars when more than one person shares it and someone has a car. The pickup wins when nobody can haul, or when the boxes have to come back to the room on a scheduled day.
Do not treat CubeSmart's $60 online price as a four-month quote. The page never says the discount lasts past the promotion.
